planner.title: 生日会
planner.goal: 认识生日会上常见的四样东西

scenes.title: 生日帽
scenes.translation: 到了生日会，Momo 戴上了一顶黄色的帽子。
scenes.narration: Momo and Lulu come to the birthday party.
scenes.bunny_line: It is a yellow hat. I like it.

scenes.title: 一杯果汁
scenes.translation: Lulu 给大家倒了一杯果汁。
scenes.narration: Lulu pours juice into a cup.
scenes.bunny_line: Yes, you can. Be gentle with it.

scenes.title: 圆圆的球
scenes.narration: The friends play on the grass.
scenes.momo_line: I kick the ball to you.

scenes.title: 泰迪熊
scenes.translation: Momo 找到了一只泰迪熊，要轻轻抱它。
scenes.narration: A teddy sits under the table.

scenes.title: 唱生日歌
scenes.translation: 大家围在一起唱生日歌。
scenes.momo_line: I wear my hat. I am four years old.
scenes.bunny_line: Happy birthday! You are four now.

scenes.title: 美好的一天
scenes.translation: 派对结束了，大家都很开心。
scenes.narration: The party is over and the sun goes down.
scenes.momo_line: Thank you for the nice day.
scenes.bunny_line: Keep your ball, my good friend.

rounds.question: What do you want to wear?

replies.text: I want to wear the hat.
replies.follow_up: The hat looks great on you!
Yes, put it on your head.

replies.text: I see juice in the cup.
replies.follow_up: Hold the cup with two hands.

replies.text: We can play with the ball.

replies.follow_up: Here it comes. Roll, roll, roll!

rounds.question: Who do you want to hug?

replies.follow_up: The teddy likes a gentle hug.
Here you are. Hug it softly.

rounds.question: What do you like best today?

replies.follow_up: Me too! It is round and fun.
The teddy is a good friend.
